html:
SMTO-CTX-0002 — A step's results were too large to send to the model

GUID: f5e508d3-2549-42f7-8d17-27d29a1fb0b1
Slug: current-tool-results-exceed-context-window
Domain: CTX · Subsystem: context

What happened

  • A tool finished its work, but its output was too big to fit into the model's next request along with everything else. The results are saved and nothing was run again.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Open Settings › Agent behavior › Advanced, find Tool result preview, and lower Head characters and Tail characters. These set how much of each tool's output the model sees, and the change applies at the task's next model step.
  2. Go back to the task and select Resume if it's shown. Don't ask SMTO to run the same commands again just to see their output. The finished results are already saved, and running the commands again could repeat changes they made.
  3. If it still doesn't fit, start a new task that asks for less at once, for example one folder or one file at a time. Some steps need more room than the model has, even with short previews.

What success looks like

  • The task moves past this step and SMTO shows its next action.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't raise Output allowance to make room; it takes space away from the task's material.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • The next model request could not be built because preserved completed tool results, even as previews, plus required context exceed the model's input capacity; this retained error comes from an earlier SMTO version.

What this means

  • This retained error identifies a completed-result capacity failure from an earlier runtime. Exact receipts remain preserved. Current model preparation uses head/tail previews, ordinary compaction and proportional preview reduction. If required context and minimal previews still cannot fit, it reports a capacity failure without rerunning tools.

Why this can happen

  • Earlier runtimes protected complete current output in Full delivery mode. Current runtimes use the single text-preview policy.

How to diagnose it

  • Compare input counts and available capacity, retaining their measured or estimated labels. Check the current global Head characters and Tail characters settings.
  • Confirm the completed operation’s exact receipt remains present. Retrieve missing text through its advertised recovery action.

How to fix it

  • Reduce Head characters and Tail characters of tool_result_preview (Settings › Agent behavior › Advanced; applies at the next model call) or reduce required context; current prepare_context also shrinks previews automatically under pressure. Do not raise max completion tokens. Do not rerun completed operations to recover their output; exact receipts stay preserved.
  • Adjust Head characters and Tail characters under Tool result preview; changes apply at the next model call. Automatic previews shrink under context pressure. If required context still cannot fit, increase input capacity or reduce required context. Do not rerun completed work to retrieve output.

Relevant SMTO settings

  • Open Tool result preview: advanced / tool_result_preview. Applies to: new operation.

Retry and execution caution

  • Apply the correction and confirm the relevant state before requesting another attempt. Prior completed work remains governed by its receipts.

How to verify the fix

  • Confirm the next request uses the current preview allowances and fits available input capacity.
  • Confirm next-request preparation succeeds and previous exact receipts remain preserved without rerunning completed work.

What not to do

  • Do not increase max completion tokens as the primary fix; reserving more output reduces input headroom.
  • Do not claim an inference response occurred when the model request did not start.
  • Do not treat this as malformed provider output when model_request_started is false.
  • Do not delete exact receipts or rerun completed mutations to reduce context.
  • Do not increase reserved output as the first fix; it reduces input capacity.
  • Resume uses current global preview settings; historical execution evidence remains unchanged.

Technical notes

  • This capacity branch occurs before the next inference request starts. Prior tool receipts are preserved and token estimates retain provenance.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
